messages_added: [4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] Speaker Caroline says: Ah, they're adorable! What are their names? Pets sure do bring so much joy to us!
[5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023] Speaker Audrey says: Wow, that view looks great! It really captures that calming and peaceful feeling. It must be really satisfying to capture that tranquility.

[7:52 pm on 7 August, 2023] Speaker Evan says: Hey Sam, how's it going? Last week I went on a trip to Canada and something unreal happened - I met this awesome Canadian woman and it was like something out of a movie. She's incredible and being with her makes me feel alive.

[7:20 pm on 16 June, 2023] Speaker John says: Thanks, Maria! It can be challenging, so I try to organize my time and make sure I'm there for the important things. It's all about finding that balance and making those moments count!
[7:31 pm on 21 January, 2022] Speaker Nate says: Wow, movies can be so powerful! Do you have any recommendations for me?
[5:44 pm on 3 June, 2022] Speaker Joanna says: Thanks Nate! See you later!
[1:24 pm on 25 May, 2023] Speaker John says: Glad the photo made you feel that way, Maria. Cherish those little moments!
[4:07 pm on 14 October, 2023] Speaker Sam says: We're traveling through Lake Tahoe! I heard it's great for kayaking.
[8:43 pm on 3 July, 2023] Speaker Maria says: Wow, John! It's great to see you standing up for your beliefs.
[2:14 pm on 13 October, 2022] Speaker John says: So cool that people are enjoying it! What inspired you to create it?
[3:47 pm on 17 March, 2022] Speaker John says: Heard about VR gaming? It's pretty immersive. We can try it together!

[12:09 am on 13 September, 2023] Speaker Caroline says: Melanie, those bowls are amazing! They each have such cool designs. I love that you chose pottery for your art. Painting and drawing have helped me express my feelings and explore my gender identity. Creating art was really important to me during my transition - it helped me understand and accept myself. I'm so grateful.
[7:34 pm on 18 April, 2023] Speaker John says: Talking with the group of people who were as stoked as me on tech for change was awesome! It made me think we really can make a difference.
[9:03 pm on 9 February, 2023] Speaker Deborah says: That makes sense. I'm excited to hear how you reach out and help those kids. Let me know how it goes!
[2:18 pm on 12 September, 2023] Speaker Jolene says: I look forward to meeting you and playing this game!
[9:36 am on 2 April, 2023] Speaker John says: Maria, thanks a lot! Your support is really encouraging - I appreciate having you in my corner!
[8:56 pm on 20 July, 2023] Speaker Caroline says: Sounds special, those beach trips! Do you have any other summer traditions you all do together? Create those memories!
[2:15 pm on 21 June, 2023] Speaker Gina says: Believe in yourself and keep going. You can do it!
[6:03 pm on 5 September, 2022] Speaker Joanna says: Got it Nate, I'll see you soon!
[2:52 pm on 31 August, 2023] Speaker Tim says: That's ok! I can look some up. Can you tell me what spices you used in the soup?
[6:03 pm on 6 March, 2023] Speaker John says: Wow, Maria! I see, so that's the key to making a difference.
[3:19 pm on 28 August, 2023] Speaker Caroline says: Wow, what a fun moment! What's the band?
[10:47 am on 6 May, 2023] Speaker Andrew says: Thanks! Your help is much appreciated. I'm still on the lookout for the perfect furry friend.

[10:04 am on 19 December, 2023] Speaker John says: Our team has seen the most growth in communication and bonding. It has really helped our performances by allowing us to understand each other's strengths and weaknesses.

[2:32 pm on 29 January, 2023] Speaker Jon says: Yeah, can't wait to see it done! Looking for the right place and getting everything ready has been a mix of exciting and nerve-wracking, but I'm determined to make it work. It'll be worth it!
[4:20 pm on 15 August, 2023] Speaker Sam says: The cooking class has been great, I've learned awesome recipes. Last night I made this yummy grilled dish, so good!

[9:37 pm on 11 January, 2024] Speaker Sam says: Hey Evan, been a few days since we last chatted. Hope you're doing OK. A lot's happened since then. Got issues with my health, it's been rough. Feels like this weight's keeping me from fully living. Trying to stay positive, not easy.
[5:26 pm on 2 January, 2024] Speaker John says: Yeah! That's why I love traveling - it's a way to learn about different cultures and places.

[8:29 pm on 13 June, 2023] Speaker Jon says: Thanks, Gina! It's been so inspiring to work with our young dancers, seeing their passion and commitment. Opening the dance studio's been a great experience - I want it to be a place of support and encouragement for all our dancers. Will you show me this presentation?
[3:56 pm on 6 June, 2023] Speaker Deborah says:  How has it inspired you to keep striving for your dreams?
[4:12 pm on 22 February, 2023] Speaker Jolene says: Sorry to hear about your friend, Deb. Losing someone can be really tough. How are you holding up?
[9:19 am on 2 September, 2023] Speaker Dave says: Cool! Let me know when you're free and we can catch up in Boston.
[8:16 pm on 25 October, 2022] Speaker Nate says: They eat a combination of vegetables, fruits, and insects. They have a varied diet.
[4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] Speaker Melanie says: Wow, Caroline. We've come so far, but there's more to do. Your drive to help is awesome! What's your plan to pitch in?

[4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] Speaker Caroline says: I struggled with mental health, and support I got was really helpful. It made me realize how important it is for others to have a support system. So, I started looking into counseling and mental health career options, so I could help other people on their own journeys like I was helped.

[8:16 pm on 5 December, 2023] Speaker Sam says: The meeting was really insightful, and that smoothie bowl was a hit! Yoga's a great choice, it's done wonders for my flexibility and stress levels. You should definitely try it.
[8:30 pm on 1 January, 2023] Speaker Maria says: Wow, John! That's amazing news. It's great to see you finding such a supportive community that is making a difference.
[9:23 pm on 4 September, 2022] Speaker James says: Take care, John, bye!

[7:49 pm on 6 September, 2023] Speaker Audrey says: That's great! Glad you found ways to relax. It's nice to have those little moments of joy. Something cool recently happened with my furry friends - I organized a doggy playdate with the neighbors' dogs. Seeing all those tails wagging was so sweet. They must have had so much fun!
[9:48 am on 4 February, 2023] Speaker Deborah says:  I'm sure great things will keep coming your way. Keep up the good work and follow your passions!
[5:35 pm on 22 March, 2023] Speaker Deborah says: I am glad, it was helpful. Let's give it a try and see if it helps you stay focused and less stressed.
